summary: Verified the pricing-cards bug fix end-to-end. The 3 Dashboard pricing cards (extra/single/family) now call openPaywall() only; the PaywallModal overlays the dashboard without unmounting the hero/stat/pricing sections. Backend /api/subscription/{status,checkout,confirm} work with Bearer demo_session_fase1. Plan activation via plan-single-cta mock payment converts PricingCards into the confirmation strip (Piano attuale + Single Illimitato + pricing-manage-link) while keeping Ciao hero and other dashboard sections mounted. Settings page shows the new plan (Single Illimitato). No console errors/warnings during the flow.
critical_code_review_comments: PaywallModal.jsx: catch block swallows the real error (`catch {}`). Consider logging the error for easier debugging of real Stripe failures later.
subscription.jsx: refresh() ignores errors silently; a one-time console.warn would help diagnose auth/session expiry at the status endpoint.
test_credentials: Bearer/Cookie session_token=demo_session_fase1 (user_id=demo-fase1-user). Reset to honeymoon FREE state after testing.
seed_data_creation: Upserted demo-fase1-user with plan=FREE, honeymoon created_at=today; reset to FREE at end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Flow verified: card click -> paywall overlay (dashboard stays mounted) -> close via X btn or backdrop restores cards -> plan-single-cta mock payment (~900ms) -> paywall closes -> PricingCards becomes confirmation strip with pricing-manage-link -> Settings reflects new plan. Demo user reset to FREE/honeymoon at end of run so tests are rerunnable.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous bug: PricingCards returned null after plan activation, causing the whole pricing section to vanish right after click (because cards used to call checkout+confirm directly on click). Fix: card onClick now only openPaywall(); only plan-*-cta inside PaywallModal triggers checkout+confirm; after activation PricingCards renders a confirmation strip instead of returning null. Verified via Playwright: dashboard sections remain mounted throughout.
